items.a: YoYo is invite-only. You can enter the hidden loop only with a personal invitation code shared by a member or a founder.

items.q: My invitation code isn't working. What should I do?
items.a: Make sure the code is typed exactly as received. If it still doesn't unlock access, contact us at yoyoclub.hello@gmail.com.

items.q: How do I earn YoYo Credits?
items.a: Make reservations through the app, visit partner venues, and submit your receipt via WhatsApp using Add Points on the back of your card. Every experience returns something back to you.
Open the Rewards Vault, choose your perk, and tap Redeem. We'll guide you through the next steps directly on WhatsApp.

items.q: Can I update my name, email, or phone number?
items.a: Yes. Email yoyoclub.hello@gmail.com and our team will securely update your details.

items.q: What happens if I delete my account?
items.a: All your data and YoYo Credits will be permanently removed. If you choose to return later, you'll need a new invitation code to re-enter.

items.q: How do I make a reservation?
items.a: Select a partner venue, choose your date and time, and we'll confirm your booking via WhatsApp. Doors open fast — and availability is limited.

items.q: I didn't receive my verification email.
items.a: Check your spam or promotions folder. If it's not there, email yoyoclub.hello@gmail.com.

items.q: Why do I need to send my receipt through WhatsApp to earn credits?
items.a: During our MVP phase, receipts help us manually verify your visit and assign YoYo Credits accurately. This ensures every credit you earn is real.

items.q: How can I invite someone to join YoYo?
items.a: Invitation codes are granted based on your activity and level. If you receive one, we'll send it to you directly via WhatsApp.
